'''Nasin Caeren''' was a high ranking [[Andoran]] noble. He was the previous [[High Seat]] of [[House Caeren]]. 

==Appearance==
He was bony, goat-faced and gaunt with thin white hair{{ref/book|5|19}}{{ref/book|6|1}}. 

==History==
He was married to [[Miedelle Caeren]], who died around {{ne|970}}. They had at least one child (gender unknown) who had at least one child, [[Sylvase Caeren]].

Along with Lord [[Jarid Sarand]], Lady [[Elenia Sarand]], Lady [[Arymilla Marne]], Lady [[Naean Arawn]], Lord [[Lir Baryn]] and Lady [[Karind Anshar]], he opposed [[Morgase Trakand]] when she claimed the [[Lion Throne]]. 

He was forced to acknowledge [[Morgase Trakand]] as the Queen after she was successful in her claim{{ref/book|5|19}}.

==Activities==
[[File:Nasin.jpg|left|Nasin Caeren according to the WoT CCG]]He was seen in the Throne Room of Caemlyn Palace when Lord Gaebril was active in Andor. After [[Rand al'Thor]] enters [[Caemlyn]] and defeated Gaebril, he seemed to have become a little addled{{ref/book|5|19}}.

A group of nobles including Arymilla, Elenia, Jarid, Karind, Naean, Lir, Henren, Carlys, Daerilla, Elegar, and Lord Nasin watches Rand practice the sword against five men in a courtyard of the Royal Palace in Caemlyn. Nasin tells Rand he is another [[Jearom]]{{ref/book|6|1}}. Lord Nasin gasps and panics when Taim is lead into the courtyard{{ref/book|6|2}}. 

He initially supported [[Arymilla Marne]] for the Lion Throne{{ref/book|9|p}}. He seems to believe that Elenia is his betrothed and fawns over her and that Arymilla is his daughter{{ref/book|10|15}}. Arymilla encourages this misconception, playing along with his delusions. She forces a series of minor noblewomen and servants, as well as her own maid to sleep with him in order to redirect his advances towards Elenia. Arymilla uses him to keep Elenia off-balance and under her control.

With the support of Elenia, Naean and Nasin, Arymilla brings four armies to lay siege to Caemlyn{{ref/book|9|27}}{{ref/book|10|p}}. 

When eighty of [[Luan Norwelyn|Lord Luan]]'s armsmen led by [[Jurad Accan]] are attacked by Lord Nasin's troops, [[Doilin Mellar]] leads a sortie to rescue them and bring them into Caemlyn{{ref/book|10|11}}. 

Arymilla dines with Naean, Elenia, Karind, Lir, Nasin and Sylvase to prepare the last attack{{ref/book|11|17}}. 

According to his grand-daughter, [[Sylvase Caeren]], he died of a fit just before Arymilla's forces were defeated during the [[Fourth Succession War|Siege of Caemlyn]]{{ref/book|11|33}}. This seems suspiciously convenient. Sylvase is considered ruthless by Elayne, she thinks the girl has a very hard core. Probably she somehow during the battle killed her grand-father, though Elenia also may have been behind the death as previously she was considering whether to kill him or Arymillia first {{ref/book|10|15}}.
